rows.r: Adding config or feature flags is artifact content; whether an addition is speculative depends on the current task.
Compliance couples a failed check, a bypass, and an explanation; the applicable checks require project lookup.
Identifying production code and the stated API or callback exceptions requires repository context.
Determining which occurrences are in production paths requires repository context.
The rule constrains artifact text, and sensitive or identifying information is an unresolved project concept.
The block instructs the agent to select and use the appropriate skill; skill invocation is observable and suitability depends on the current job.
The prohibited translation targets are explicit, so no additional context is required.
This is a language rule for documentation rather than implementation code.
Moving or deleting a protected file must be coupled with consumer updates; the relevant files and consumers are listed explicitly.
External file references direct file access, and all referenced paths are explicit.
